name: Riverline Xiangqi
subtitle: 3D Chinese chess
shortDescription: Riverline Xiangqi is Chinese chess made carefully: a real-time 3D board with carved men, a computer opponent you can trust at eight levels, and a coach…
longDescription:
Riverline Xiangqi is Chinese chess made carefully: a real-time 3D board with carved men, a computer opponent you can trust at eight levels, and a coach, lessons and puzzles that help you improve.

### Play
- Eight computer levels from a curious beginner to a strong master, plus an adaptive mode that follows your rating.
- Pass & Play for two people on one device, with the board turning to face each player.
- Watch & Learn: two computers play while plain-language comments explain each move. Pause, speed up, or take over at any moment.
- Clocks (15 minutes, 10+5, 5+3, 3+2), undo, hints and the exact rules: palace, river, flying General, elephant eyes, horse legs, cannon screens, stalemate loss, and the perpetual check and perpetual chase rulings.

### Learn
- A coach grades every move you make, explains mistakes and draws the better move on the board.
- 14 interactive lessons: the board, every man, check and mate, repetition rules, values, four mating patterns, opening principles and endgames.
- 90 engine-verified puzzles in a seven-chapter campaign (mate in one to four, winning material, two endgame labs) with three stars each, a puzzle rating and a daily challenge with streak and calendar.
- An opening trainer with 12 classic lines in learn and test modes, and automatic opening recognition during play.
- Game review with an evaluation graph, accuracy for both sides, graded moves and key moments.
- An exhaustive Rules page with diagrams, and a short Story of Xiangqi.

### Beautiful
- Three sets of men: boxwood and ink, lacquer and gold, and jade. Three boards: maple, midnight and gold, celadon.
- Real carved lettering on every man: traditional characters, Latin letters (K A E H R C P) or both.
- Warm lantern light, shadows, smooth animation and carefully tuned sound. Portrait and landscape on phones and tablets, with text zoom up to 300% on reading pages and lessons.

### Yours
- Works fully offline. Free to play with ads (one purchase removes them), no account.
- Moves written in standard WXF notation or in Chinese notation, and shareable as text.
- Trophies, statistics and ratings stay on your device.

Free to play with ads; one purchase removes them for good. No subscription.
